source: Objective 2 Tamil Nadu pipeline stages g2-g24 (scripts/tn_run_all.py). Built by src/handoff/build_obj3_contract_tamilnadu.py.
supersession_note: SUPERSEDES objective3/obj3_environment_contract_tamilnadu.json (contract_version obj3_contract_v2.0_2026-09-17, file dated 2026-10-27) ENTIRELY. That contract described designs that no longer exist: n-Hexacosane (C26) and n-Pentacosane (C25) in radial / single-layer arrangements, 32-35 capsules of 72-80 mm, 4.9-7.4 kg PCM, in a 50 L tank with a 1.5 m2 collector. The released designs are PureTemp 58 / RT57HC, staggered, 98-105 capsules of 81.6 mm, 23.6-25.3 kg PCM, in a 100 L tank with a 2.5 m2 collector. Its claims that PCM loses to a plain tank in every regime (-12.5% to -14.8%) and that P(meets demand) is 0-4% are both FALSE for the current designs: the held-out test has PCM beating the water-only twin in 9 of 9 designs. Objective 3 must read THIS file. Any cached copy of the older contract, or of OBJECTIVE3_INPUTS_AND_NEXT_STEPS.md dated 2026-10-27, must be discarded.

dynamic_state_schema.description: One observation per control timestep. Fields marked measurable=false need an estimator (energy-balance + calibrated melt-fraction observer), not a raw sensor.

fields.name: f_melt_t
fields.source: estimator, derived from T_pcm_t via the frozen enthalpy model

fields.name: D_t
fields.source: flow meter at the draw-off point

fields.name: dp_t
fields.source: differential pressure sensor or Ergun estimate from mdot_t

fields.name: E_unmet_t
fields.source: estimator, from T_out_t vs delivery target

fields.name: T_water_top_C
fields.source: sensor at the tank outlet - this is the DELIVERY temperature

fields.name: T_water_bottom_C
fields.source: sensor at the collector return - this is the collector INLET

fields.name: recoverable_energy_above_45C_kWh
fields.source: estimator (WP1 E_rec,45), not a raw sensor

dynamic_state_schema.stratification_note: The tank is stratified and multi-node. Delivery temperature is the TOP node; the collector inlet is the BOTTOM node. Loop flow sets stratification, not collector heat.

safety_shield.enforced_in: src/simulation/tank_model.py - inside the physics, NOT in the policy
safety_shield.note: This is ALREADY ENFORCED, not a specification to implement. The shield forces the collector off at 72 C water / 62 C PCM, a 3 C guard band below the 75/65 C hard limits. The acceptance-test item 'the shield cannot be bypassed by the policy' therefore passes trivially against the baseline. Objective 3's job is to build a BETTER controller than this blunt reactive trip - one that anticipates the limit instead of reacting at it.
safety_shield.standard: IS 12976:2023 Sec 8.2 validates this exact mechanism for overheat protection.

reward_function.status: SUGGESTED. Weights are deliberately NOT chosen - Objective 3 sets and justifies them. The w1..w5 defaults in the 2026-10-27 contract came from retired designs and are NOT carried over.

term_definitions.E_del45_t: energy delivered up to the 45 C target in this step. The WP1 window is 18:00-09:00; night and morning steps may be weighted more.
term_definitions.overheat_step_t: shield-active time in the step (the quantity behind d_overheat)
term_definitions.safety_violation_t: 1 if TOP water >= 72 C or PCM >= 62 C (the shield guard band), else 0
term_definitions.bypass_switch_t: 1 if the mode changes into bypass at this step, else 0

reward_function.removed_terms: The pump-energy term is removed: pump energy is not meaningful in this model, which has only an Ergun pressure drop across the capsule bed.
reward_function.normalisation: To be computed by Objective 3 from the water-only twin of the chosen design over the explore years 2016-2020.

design_space_caveats.statement: The designs above are the best found WITHIN the declared search bounds under a pre-declared selection rule. They are not proven global optima.
design_space_caveats.binding_bound_pcm_fraction: The 30% PCM-fraction cap IS BINDING. The g17 widened-bound diagnostic shows that at 40% the window gain is higher by more than the repeatability band in EVERY regime, with PCM and water peaks still inside 65 C and 75 C. The cap is administrative: the packing engine accepts 28-48% at R 40 mm, and the only literature in the files read (Chen 2025) covers 10-20%. A 40% run is planned, not done.
design_space_caveats.flow_optimum_may_be_artefact: collector.flow_dependent_fr.enabled is FALSE, so F_R does not vary with flow in this model. Any optimum sitting at the low flow bound is therefore suspect. Objective 3 MUST NOT treat the inherited nominal flow as a physical optimum to defend; it is a starting point inside a verified-safe envelope. g17 does establish that the UPPER flow bound is not limiting (0.080 kg/s moves g_window by less than the band).
design_space_caveats.radius_bound_not_limiting: R 45 mm and R 50 mm are both below the chosen design in every regime, so 40 mm sits at or near an interior optimum.

temperature_specification.note: Four temperatures appear across O1 and O2 and have been mistaken for contradictions. They are different physical quantities.

o1_T_DELIVERY_C.meaning: delivery temperature Objective 1 sizes the night load against (Avargani et al. 2021)

o1_DT_APPROACH_C.meaning: driving dT a PCM needs above delivery

o1_TM_TARGET_C.meaning: aspirational PCM melting target (= delivery + approach)

o1_Tm_target_capped_C.meaning: THE OPERATIVE CEILING. Feasibility Constraint 6 is Tm <= this. Capped by achievability via kt_worst_month.

o2_delivery_target_temp_C.meaning: threshold at which O2 MEASURES usable delivered energy

temperature_specification.is_67C_vs_65C_a_safety_problem: NO. TM_TARGET_C=67 C never reaches a selection decision. Constraint 6 screens on Tm_target_capped_C (mean 61.45 C); every shortlisted PCM melts at 54.0-58.0 C; and the held-out test measured PCM peaks of 63.4-64.0 C, inside the 65 C limit. Objective 3 inherits NO safety risk from this figure.
temperature_specification.open_item_service_mismatch: Objective 1 sizes latent heat for a 60 C delivery service while Objective 2 scores delivered energy at 45 C. O2's comparison is sound (both arms of every paired run use the same 45 C metric), but whether O1 would have shortlisted different PCMs had it sized against 45 C is UNQUANTIFIED. Open.

simulator_verification.evidence: 89 tests pass; Gate-1 energy balance residual within tolerance; g2 timestep convergence

model_consistency_cross_check.method: ANSYS Fluent, enthalpy-porosity, one capsule / six hours
caveats: three v3 cases returned 0% liquid fraction
first-order upwind is the only scheme under which all four PCMs converge, so melt fractions are conservative
symmetry half-slice mesh excludes buoyancy-driven melt convection

verification_status.o1_physics_agreement: WEAK AND NOT STATISTICALLY SIGNIFICANT. Objective 1's MCDM ranking vs its own physics model gives mean Spearman rho = +0.169 (per cluster +0.381/+0.103/+0.024), p = 0.12-0.96, n = 8-10 per cluster. The PCM shortlist Objective 2 inherited is an MCDM consensus ranking, NOT a physics-confirmed one.
verification_status.wording_rule: Say 'simulator verification', 'model consistency cross-check' and 'experimental validation' - never 'CFD-validated' or 'physics-validated'.

deferred_future_work: 40% PCM-fraction run (the binding cap, see design_space_caveats)
flow-dependent collector F_R: the model's F_R is flow-independent, so any flow optimum at the low bound is a model artefact
dense-grid cross-check for rank-2/3 PCM pairs (only rank-1 pairs have one)
g18 novert/vert states were never run; that with/without comparison is incomplete
CFD-derived PCM resistance correction is NOT applied (lumped r/(5k) with a liquid-convection factor of 2.0)
node-count (N=10 vs 20) uncertainty is inside the WP6 band, not removed
objective_boundary: Objective 1 selected the PCM shortlist. Objective 2 selected the physical design (PCM identity, capsule geometry, arrangement, flow) and the validated operating envelope. OBJECTIVE 3 SELECTS THE REAL-TIME ACTION AND NOTHING ELSE. It must not change PCM identity, capsule geometry, tank volume, safety limits, or the released physics model, and must not re-cluster or merge the regimes.
